headline: Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’
summary: Capcom is exploring integrating AI into game development for future projects. A presentation detailed their "REX Project" to evolve the RE Engine for AI collaboration. This vision aims for shared game creation with AI, contrasting themes in their game Pragmata.

headline: The best early October Prime Day deals happening now
summary: Amazon is offering early Prime Big Deal Day discounts before October Prime Day. Deals include sales on Amazon's own hardware and other popular products. The official October Prime Day runs from October 6th to 8th.

headline: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava thinks AI emails are killing conversations
summary: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava voiced concerns that AI-generated emails diminish genuine conversations. Srivastava leads the sample platform used in major music hits like Sabrina Carpenter's "Espresso." Her comments highlight a growing debate on AI's impact on human communication.

headline: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
summary: David Robinson, a former OpenAI safety report writer, has resigned from his position. He is now publicly warning about the dangers of AI in an editorial for The Atlantic. His departure raises concerns within the AI safety community.

headline: 'I Did My Best' — Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Director Responds to Fans Asking for Full Disc Version
summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi addressed fan requests for a full disc release. He stated he fought for physical media but acknowledged the industry's shift towards digital distribution. Hamaguchi recognized a future where physical game discs are becoming obsolete.

headline: Carrie, Avatar, and More of the Most Anticipated Movies and TV Shows to Stream in October
summary: A list of anticipated movies and TV shows set to stream in October has been released. Highlights include a new Mike Flanagan adaptation of a Stephen King story. Other notable mentions are a Friday the 13th prequel and the Season 1 finale of "Lanterns."

headline: Save Big On Tolkien's Lord of the Rings and Hobbit Books Ahead of Prime Day
summary: J.R.R. Tolkien's classic works, including "The Lord of the Rings" and "The Hobbit," are discounted. These special offers are available on Amazon ahead of the upcoming Prime Day event. Fans can save on beloved fantasy novels and related titles like "The Silmarillion."

headline: Love and Deepspace Devs Issue Warning to Players After Deadly Drink Recipes Go Viral
summary: Developers for the RPG-dating sim "Love and Deepspace" issued a warning to players. The warning followed the viral spread of fictional, potentially deadly drink recipes from the game. Devs cautioned against consuming the real-world ingredients due to "disastrous" consequences.

headline: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
summary: A Flydubai co-pilot reportedly attacked his captain with an axe during a flight. The incident occurred on an Israel-bound jet, according to a UAE official. The accused individual has been identified by media outlets as Hamam al-Hammami.

headline: UK-Iranian dual national arrested over RAF Fairford released on bail
summary: A 25-year-old UK-Iranian dual national was arrested in London. The arrest was linked to an incident at RAF Fairford. He has since been released on bail.

headline: Kemi Badenoch has cemented her image. Now she wants to put her party back on the big stage
summary: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch aims to elevate her party's national standing. She is expected to outline a return to core conservative principles. These plans will be presented at the party's upcoming annual conference.

headline: 'Anger in the streets': Tens of thousands protest in Spain over housing crisis
summary: Tens of thousands of people are protesting across Spain over a severe housing crisis. Over 50 demonstrations occurred after the government failed to pass emergency housing legislation. Widespread public anger highlights a growing dissatisfaction with housing affordability and policy.
